sql.observations:
SELECT pd.domain,
	                      ARRAY(
	                        SELECT DISTINCT o.id
	                          FROM unnest(pd.org_ids) AS u(id)
	                          JOIN org o ON o.id = u.id
	                         WHERE o.dept = ANY($1::text[])
	                      )::int[] AS "orgIds",
	                      pd.ns, pd.mx
	                 FROM provider_domain pd
	                WHERE pd.last_state <> 'erreur'
	                ORDER BY pd.domain
sql.baseline:
SELECT (SELECT reltuples::bigint FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'org'::regclass) AS organizations,
	                  (SELECT count(*) FROM source) AS sources,
	                  (SELECT count(*) FROM event) AS events
